The viaduct is noted for its height, (being an average of 122 ft high, but at its maximum, to the top of the parapet level, it is 136 ft), leading one journalist to describe it as "One of the most stupendous structures of ancient or modern times." One local challenge has been to "lob" a cricket ball over the viaduct, with some claiming that they have.

candidates.description: Secondary school in Huddersfield, West Yorkshire, England
candidates.extract: Newsome Academy (formerly Newsome High School and Newsome High School & Sports College) is a co-educational secondary school located in Newsome (near Huddersfield), West Yorkshire, England.

candidates.name: Lockwood, Huddersfield
candidates.description: Suburb of Huddersfield in West Yorkshire, England
candidates.extract: Lockwood is an area of Huddersfield, in the Metropolitan Borough of Kirklees, West Yorkshire, England. It is 0.9 mi to the southwest of Huddersfield Town Centre, to the west of the River Holme.

candidates.name: Armitage Bridge
candidates.description: Village in West Yorkshire, England
candidates.extract: Armitage Bridge is a village approximately 3 mi south of Huddersfield, in the Holme Valley, West Yorkshire, England. It is situated between Berry Brow and South Crosland and straddles the River Holme.

candidates.name: Thornton Lodge
candidates.description: Suburb of Huddersfield, West Yorkshire, England
candidates.extract: Thornton Lodge is a suburb of Huddersfield, West Yorkshire. It borders Crosland Moor to the west, Lockwood to the south, and Longroyd Bridge to the north.

candidates.name: Beaumont Park
candidates.description: Suburb of Huersfield, West Yorkshire, England
candidates.extract: Beaumont Park is a suburb of Huddersfield in the Metropolitan Borough of Kirklees, West Yorkshire, England, located between Netherton, Crosland Moor and Lockwood.

candidates.name: Newsome
candidates.description: Village in West Yorkshire, England
candidates.extract: Newsome is a village situated approximately 1 mile south of Huddersfield, West Yorkshire, England. It is in the Metropolitan Borough of Kirklees.

candidates.name: Berry Brow
candidates.description: Village in West Yorkshire, England
candidates.extract: Berry Brow is a semi-rural village in West Yorkshire, England, situated about 2 mi south of Huddersfield. It lies on the eastern bank of the Holme Valley and partially straddles the A616 road to Honley and Penistone.

candidates.name: Longroyd Bridge
candidates.description: Suburb of Huddersfield, West Yorkshire, England
candidates.extract: Longroyd Bridge is a suburb approximately 1200 yds (1.1 km) to the southwest of Huddersfield town centre, West Yorkshire, England. The area is composed of industrial and commercial units.
